studio_philosophy.manifesto_quote: We design homes that respond to regional climate, age gracefully over decades, and create an atmosphere of quiet dignity.
studio_philosophy.manifesto_author: RAHUL DESHMUKH & PRIYA JOSHI • PRINCIPAL ARCHITECTS
paragraphs: Our practice rejects fleeting interior trends and superficial ornamentation. We believe enduring architecture is born from honest spatial proportions, natural cross-ventilation, and authentic regional materials.

Based between our head studio in Viman Nagar, Pune and our branch office in Bandra West, Mumbai, our team brings together master stonemasons, traditional woodcarvers, and structural engineers to deliver timeless residences across Maharashtra.

before_after_renovation.subtitle: PRABHAT ROAD, DECCAN GYMKHANA, PUNE • HISTORIC RESTORATION
before_after_renovation.location: Prabhat Road, Deccan Gymkhana, Pune (18.5144° N, 73.8378° E)
before_after_renovation.narrative: We restored an iconic 1948 stone bungalow in Prabhat Road, stabilizing decayed timber rafters and restoring load-bearing black basalt walls. We introduced modern plumbing, air conditioning, and double-glazed windows without compromising the building's historical integrity.

pins.title: Sahyadri Black Basalt
pins.detail: Original 1948 stone walls structurally pinned, hand-pointed with traditional lime mortar, and left exposed as focal surfaces.

pins.title: Continuous Kota Stone Floor
pins.detail: Replaced cracked subfloors with a seamless honed Kota stone slab floor with silent acoustic underlay.

pins.title: Seasoned Nilambur Teak Rafters
pins.detail: Restored original timber roof trusses treated with natural linseed oils and detailed with concealed steel ties.

pins.title: Concealed Climate Control
pins.detail: VRF cooling conduits integrated behind fluted teak paneling with zero visual clutter or duct exposure.

materials.name: Makrana Pure White Marble
materials.finish_spec: Honed bookmatched slabs with crystalline white calcite veins
materials.description: The quintessential marble of Indian historic architecture. Crystalline and cool underfoot, perfect for Pune's warm summer afternoons.

materials.name: Seasoned Nilambur Teakwood
materials.patina_cycle: Rich golden-brown grain with natural oils
materials.finish_spec: Quarter-sawn seasoned timber finished with natural organic oil
materials.description: Dense, water-resistant hardwood with rich grain and natural termite resistance, crafted by our in-house master carpenters into doors and joinery.

materials.name: Hand-Dressed Black Basalt
materials.finish_spec: Hand-chiseled rough face and honed smooth hearth blocks
materials.description: Local Maharashtra volcanic black stone providing unmatched structural honesty and a deep connection to regional Sahyadri architecture.

materials.name: Fine-Honed Green Kota Stone
materials.finish_spec: Leather-finish fine honed slabs with water-tight joints
materials.description: Naturally non-porous and cool limestone slabs that evoke classic Indian bungalows while pairing seamlessly with modern concrete and brass.

materials.name: Traditional Chunam Slaked Lime Plaster
materials.finish_spec: Hand-troweled slaked lime with river sand and natural marble dust
materials.description: A breathable, anti-fungal traditional Indian wall finish that keeps interiors naturally cool during peak summer while eliminating wall glare.

materials.name: Maheshwari & Khadi Pure Linen
materials.finish_spec: Handwoven heavyweight plain weave organic linen
materials.description: Textiles crafted on handlooms by master weavers, offering gentle daylight filtration and superior acoustic absorption for double-height living spaces.

testimonials.quote: Vastu & Arche crafted our Koregaon Park residence with exceptional sensitivity to natural light, cross-ventilation, and privacy. It feels tranquil, cool in summer, and deeply rooted in Pune's architectural heritage.
Our Prabhat Road bungalow restoration was handled with immense respect for our family's heritage. The craftsmanship in black basalt stone and teak wood is simply world-class.
A rare architecture and interior practice in Maharashtra that balances clean contemporary lines with deep technical rigor, transparent costing, and reliable on-time execution.
From initial 3D design visualizations to the final handover in Kalyani Nagar, Rahul and Priya were on site every week ensuring flawless construction quality.
